title: Vector Index Manifest
description: Provenance + integrity manifest for the on-device vector index emitted alongside embeddings.npy + id_map.json at LibV2/courses/<slug>/vector_index/manifest.json. Mirrors the conventions of chunkset_manifest.schema.json (lowercase-hex SHA fields, chunker_version alternation, additionalProperties:false). The manifest pins every replay parameter (model id/revision/dim, provider, device, batch_size, text_field_policy) so a vector index built on one machine is auditable on another and an eval run can refuse mixed-provenance comparisons. The content-hashed sections (embeddings_sha256 / id_map_sha256 / source_chunks_sha256) carry no timestamps so a rebuild over identical inputs is byte-stable; the optional generated_at field is deliberately EXCLUDED from the determinism contract. Validated by lib/validators/vector_index_manifest.py::VectorIndexManifestValidator; query-time staleness (source_chunks_sha256 vs the live chunkset) is enforced fail-closed by LibV2/tools/libv2/vector_index.py::load_vector_index.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Const '1.0' in this revision; bumped only when the manifest emit shape changes.

embedding_provider.description: Embedding provider registry key (lib.embedding.providers._EMBEDDING_PROVIDERS), e.g. 'st', 'local-openai', 'fake'. The query path refuses a manifest with embedding_provider=='fake' unless ED4ALL_EMBEDDING_ALLOW_FAKE is set (anti-production-poisoning).

embedding_kind.description: Execution kind dispatched internally by EmbeddingClient. Drives how the index was built and how a query is re-embedded.

embedding_model_id.description: Model identifier the index was built with (ST id, e.g. 'BAAI/bge-m3', or a server-side model name, or the fake-provider sentinel).

embedding_model_revision.description: HF commit SHA / revision pin of the embedding model when resolvable (in-process ST), else null (server-side models, fake provider). Optional in practice but always present in the dict (null when unknown).

embedding_dim.description: Embedding dimensionality. Must equal embeddings.npy's column count (validator cross-checks).

normalized.description: Whether the stored row vectors are L2-normalized. Const true in 1.0 (exact cosine == dot product on unit vectors).

index_type.description: Index engine. Const-style enum 'exact-numpy' in 1.0 (pure-numpy brute-force exact cosine search); the enum reserves room for a future ANN backend without a schema-version bump of the rest of the contract.

chunker_version.description: Chunker-schema-contract version of the chunks that were embedded (Trainforge.chunker.CHUNKER_SCHEMA_VERSION, e.g. 'v4'). Pattern alternation accepts both the 'v4' contract form and the legacy semver form for back-compat — mirrors chunkset_manifest.schema.json.

chunkset_kind.description: Which resolved chunkset was embedded. 'imscc' (imscc_chunks/), 'dart' (dart_chunks/), or 'corpus-legacy' (pre-Phase-7c corpus/ dir). Resolved via lib.libv2_storage.resolve_imscc_chunks_dir precedence unless the build was pinned with --chunkset.

source_chunks_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex, lowercase) of the chunks.jsonl that was embedded. The load-bearing staleness signal: load_vector_index recomputes the live chunkset SHA and raises SemanticIndexStale on mismatch (anti-silent-degradation).

embeddings_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex, lowercase) of embeddings.npy bytes. Validator + verify re-hash the on-disk file and fail closed on tamper.

chunks_count.description: Number of embedded chunks. Invariant: chunks_count == len(id_map.chunk_ids) == embeddings.shape[0].

text_field_policy.description: What string was embedded per chunk. 'text+heading' (default, D6: section_heading + newline + text), 'text' (body only), or 'retrieval_text' (BM25-tuned summary; reserved A/B arm). Recorded so a re-pin is unambiguous and an eval run can refuse mixed-policy comparisons.

batch_size.description: Encode batch size used at build time. A replay parameter (determinism contract).

device.description: Compute device used at build time ('cpu' | 'cuda' | server-side sentinel). cpu is the determinism default; a cuda build is allowed for speed but recorded so a mixed-device eval comparison can be refused.

document_prefix.description: Asymmetric-retrieval passage prefix prepended to every embedded passage at build time (e.g. nomic's 'search_document: '). Empty string for symmetric models (and for bge, whose instruction prefix is query-side only). Recorded so a rebuild/eval can reproduce the exact passage encoding and refuse mixed-prefix comparisons. Optional for back-compat (pre-prefix manifests omit it; absent == '').

query_prefix.description: Asymmetric-retrieval query prefix applied query-side at search time (e.g. nomic's 'search_query: ', bge's 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: '). Recorded alongside document_prefix for full replay provenance of the query/passage asymmetry. Optional for back-compat (absent == '').

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) of the build. Optional, and deliberately EXCLUDED from the byte-stable determinism contract (a rebuild over identical inputs differs only in this field).
